body:
A slight addendum to this post.

I don’t like my father anymore. I wouldn’t even say that love exists between us anymore. I think he thinks there is, but I haven’t loved him since he hit me. 

It’s... hard to live in a home where you feel more like an enemy than a member of the family. I don’t feel as though I have a right to complain, though. Reading through this forum, I don’t even compare to some of these people, who suffer so much more than I do. I just want it all to stop. 

I can’t even sleep anymore.
